cond_0001.intro: The [Company name masked] R&D Center includes a Product Testing Laboratory responsible for performance testing of [Company name masked] and competitive materials, and a Pilot Line that runs prototyping trials. This includes, but is not limited to movement of rolled roofing products from storage to test area, cutting and preparing samples, conducting testing, recording results in excel files, and communicating with lab customers to clarify needs and report results.

Bachelors or Associates Degree in science or engineering.
Knowledge of laboratory practices and more than 1 year of experience in an R&D lab.
Prior laboratory experience in ASTM mechanical testing and technical documentation.

This supports the manufacturing plants and new product development activities of the Roofing Components Business. We are looking for someone to work alongside the team and provide support to several high-volume functional areas within our Test Lab.
cond_0324.responsibilities:
Primary role will be to coordinate sample preparation and testing in support of the Product Testing Laboratory. This includes, but is not limited to, working with the team to move rolled roofing products from storage to test area, cutting and preparing samples, conducting testing, recording results in Excel files, and communicating with lab customers to clarify needs and share results.
You will work closely with the lab lead to meet customer expectations for quality, turn-around time, communication of testing status, and achievement of overall lab outcomes.
You will assist with maintenance and operation of pilot equipment, working alongside colleagues to learn and run extrusion processes. Basic mechanical skills are preferred. Lifting and standing for long periods of time will be required; worker must be able to repetitively lift objects up to 35 lbs and stand for a large portion of the day. Steel toed shoes, safety glasses, long sleeves, long pants, bump cap, cut-resistant gloves (sometimes), and CDC approved face mask (during covid) will be required.
Note: Cell phones are not allowed at the client site; shooting of photos and/or videos are strictly prohibited while inside the client facility.
cond_0324.requirements:
Bachelors or Associates Degree in science or engineering preferred.
Must be comfortable using a computer. A working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) required.
Knowledge of laboratory practices and >1 year experience in R&D lab preferred.
Prior laboratory experience in ASTM mechanical testing and technical documentation would be very helpful.
Prefer a self-starter with organization and time management skills.
Previous forklift experience is a plus.

cond_0413.intro: The [Company name masked] Roofing Components R&D Center includes a Product Testing Laboratory responsible for performance testing of [Company name masked] and competitive materials, and a Pilot Line that runs prototyping trials. This supports manufacturing plants and new product development activities of the Roofing Components Business. We are looking for an individual who will own support across several high-volume functional areas within our Test Lab.
cond_0413.responsibilities:
Primary responsibility is to execute sample preparation and testing in support of the Product Testing Laboratory. This includes, but is not limited to: moving rolled roofing products from storage to test area, cutting and preparing samples, conducting testing, recording results in Excel files, and directly communicating with lab customers to clarify needs and report results.
You will take ownership of meeting customer expectations for quality, turn-around time, and communication of testing status, working closely with the lab lead to drive overall lab outcomes.
You will also take charge of maintenance and operation of pilot equipment, including learning and running extrusion processes. Basic mechanical skills are preferred. Lifting and standing for long periods of time will be required; worker must be able to repetitively lift objects up to 35 lbs and stand for a large portion of the day. Steel toed shoes, safety glasses, long sleeves, long pants, bump cap, cut-resistant gloves (sometimes), and CDC approved face mask (during covid) will be required.
Note: Cell phones are not allowed at the client site; shooting of photos and/or videos is strictly prohibited while inside the client facility.
cond_0413.requirements:
Bachelors or Associates Degree in science or engineering preferred.
Must be comfortable using a computer. A working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) required.
Knowledge of laboratory practices and >1 year experience in R&D lab preferred.
Prior laboratory experience in ASTM mechanical testing and technical documentation would be very helpful.
Prefer a self-starter with organization and time management skills.
Previous forklift experience is a plus.
